digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime provider seam and multi-vendor support
propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is Anthropic-shaped in practice despite being provider-agnostic in principle, with hardcoded branches on provider name strings and documentation claiming base_url/api_key support that is actually rejected at runtime
Bedrock-hosted Claude is unavailable as a first-class path; only an OpenAI-compatible proxy gateway exists, which silently loses prompt caching, native structured output, and retry/timeout guarantees

pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook and ModelProfile capability introspection enable building a first-class Bedrock path alongside Anthropic without duplicating provider-selection logic across modules
Signed verdict sidecars must carry provider, model, endpoint, and support-tier provenance so consumers can distinguish first-class (Anthropic, Bedrock) from best-effort (OpenAI-compatible) results

Retry and timeout configuration on Bedrock flows through botocore.config.Config threaded to BedrockProvider, not through httpx.Timeout or tenacity, requiring per-transport guarantee semantics rather than unified implementation

Two-provider parity verification on code-review payloads and tool availability establishes that Bedrock receives the same structured inputs as direct Anthropic, independent of model selection differences
